Class MoveBlockCommand

java.lang.Object
model.player.command.move.MoveBlockCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command, MoveCommand
public final class MoveBlockCommand extends Object implements MoveCommand
Moves a blockade as one unit, using one shared direction (T-3).

      Creates the command.
      Parameters:
      player - the owner of the pieces
      blockPieces - the pieces of the blockade
      effectiveSteps - the number of steps that every piece moves
      board - the board the pieces move on
      homeEntryPolicy - decides whether the pieces may enter their HomeStraight
      travelDirection - the direction in which the blockade travels
